runtimePin.reason: Manual no-build uploads resolve function runtime in the dev context after the two-minute artifact cache expires.

staging.manualUploadIssue: CLI27.14.2 expires the function manifest cache after two minutes; no-build uploads can repackage under default dev context. A production-only runtime override was insufficient. An all-context staging-only override plus fresh packaging selects Node22 but its managed patch is still affected.

remaining.managedNodePatchRollout: Require Netlify availability/confirmation and fresh staging actual execution evidence for Node22.23.4+ before production activation.
remaining.productionVerification: Actual production patch remains unverified. After separate approval, all six functions require matching deployment/runtime evidence; observe scheduled workers passively.
remaining.scanner: Replacement fixed bridge image is prepared locally; home production bridge/host updates require separate approval.
remaining.framework: Next16.3.8 remains unchanged. Netlify October14 advisory recommends16.4.1; bounded source search found no ImageResponse/use-cache/cacheComponents usage but Server Actions are present. Separate framework security update recommended.
remaining.unreleasedWork: Migration118 reconciliation and all other unreleased CRM work are preserved separately.

limitations: No exploit payload or compromise investigation was performed.
Read-only receipt verification checks consistency/freshness of authenticated API/log evidence supplied by the caller; it does not authenticate arbitrary input provenance.
The staging server is functional but does not pass the Node advisory security gate. Neither successful builds nor major-version labels establish host patching.
No support note was sent, no production deployment was attempted and no key rotation was performed.
